text_block_list.text:
Alright... I'm definitely going to win 
next time. I was only one step away last 
time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Just... one more step. ...If only she 
weren't there—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no, no! This isn't good at all, 
su!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I won't give up. I'll seize it 
through hard work, just like my dad!"
